div.div: غَيْرُ مُخْرِقٍ , applied to a road, means [That does not cause one to be confounded, or perplexed, and unable to see his right course; or] in which one is not confounded, or perplexed, so as to be unable to see his right course. (IAar in TA: but the latter word is there written without the vowel of the ر.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
